outcome: Osteogenic differentiation (alkaline phosphatase activity, osteocalcin gene expression, osteopontin gene expression)
cohort: Human amniotic membranes were collected from healthy donors, and human adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells were used for assessment.
finding: Decellularized amniotic membrane (DAM) supported the survival and growth of stem cells, and the addition of hydroxyapatite to DAM (DAM-HA) further promoted osteogenic differentiation while maintaining viability.
